term: greatest represented degree of a selected perfection (maxime tale)
definition: GreatestDegreeBearer InAct r value m requires m to possess r and Mathlib IsGreatest of value m in the image under value of all bearers of r. Degree has only a Preorder. Distinct bearers may have equal or preorder-equivalent greatest degrees; no strict superiority, injective grading, uniqueness or total comparability is assumed.
note: Explicit greatest-degree interpretation of the quarta via superlative in its approach-to-the-most context, not a claim that Aquinas supplied a modern value function or a homogeneous ontology. The supplied interpretation of degrees and its application to analogical being remain OPEN. Mere IsMaximumIn maximality allows incomparability and is not identified with this reading.
